author: Alex Liu
text: Tucked away in the vibrant streets of Valencia, my wife and I stumbled upon what would become one of the most memorable culinary surprises of our tour through Spain. Drawn in first by the shop’s strikingly elegant packaging—an aesthetic …

author: Ayoub Mejd
text: Amazing cheesecakes! Rich, creamy, and full of flavour. Rachid was friendly, and the shop was clean and welcoming. Definitely one of the best cheesecake places I've tried. A must-visit and easily one of the top dessert spots in Valencia. Highly recommended ❤️

author: Andreea N
text:
It’s one of the best cheesecakes I’ve ever eat!
Creamy, sweet with fresh strawberries, just prefect!
Rocco was so kind and helped us choose the right size for us. We got the small size, wich is like a mini cake and was more than enough for 3 people.

author: Emely Jädicke
text: We had the pistachio cheesecake and the blueberry one and these were by far the best cheesecakes in Valencia. Very creamy and flavorful! If you like that type of cheesecake, I can highly recommend this place.

author: 정상훈
text: This cheese has astonishing quality that Authentic cheesecake must has. Super creamy but not greasy. Fascinating dairy taste but not runny texture. Also, an employee had brilliant words explaining cakes of this shop.
